faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Sonoma?
faq.answer: Sonoma homeowners typically invest $6,500 to $16,000 for a full window replacement project. This wine country gem features Spanish Colonial and Mediterranean homes near the historic Plaza, craftsman bungalows, and estate properties on the valley floor. Custom grille configurations and period-appropriate profiles for historic homes add to project cost. Single window installation starts at approximately $580.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Sonoma?
faq.answer: Yes. Sonoma requires a building permit for window replacements. Properties near the historic Sonoma Plaza may be subject to Design Review to ensure replacement windows are compatible with the historic character of the area. Our team manages all permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Sonoma?
faq.answer: For Sonoma's wine country premium market, we most frequently install Marvin Elevate for estate homes and premium wine country properties, Andersen 400-Series for craftsman and period homes, and Milgard Tuscany vinyl for suburban neighborhoods throughout the city.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Sonoma neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all of Sonoma including the Sonoma Plaza area, Seventh Street East corridor, Agua Caliente, and all surrounding wine country residential areas. Zip code: 95476.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Sonoma?
faq.answer: Most Sonoma projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
